text: 德国10年期国债的借贷成本创出2009年以来的最高水平，投资者要求对持续高企的通胀和日益加剧的政治不确定性给予更高的补偿。该国财政部周三标售了42亿欧元（49亿美元）将于2036年8月到期的债券，平均收益率为3.39%，创该期限债券17年以来的最高水平。（彭博）
text_en: Germany's 10-year bond borrowing costs hit their highest level since 2009 as investors demanded greater compensation for persistently high inflation and rising political uncertainty. The finance ministry sold 4.2 billion euros ($4.9 billion) of bonds maturing August 2036 on Wednesday at an average yield of 3.39%, the highest for that maturity in 17 years. (Bloomberg)
